label: common_1000_friend_02
text:
This is the Zero Gate.\c
It was made so researchers could try to observe
the inside of the Great Crater of Paldea...
What folks call Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1000_friend_03
text: It’s our ticket down into the crater.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1000_friend_06
text: Oh, and speaking of the crater... You know that\nPokémon of yours? The one I gave you?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1000_friend_08
text: Maybe it’ll be happy that it can finally come\nback home?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1000_friend_09
text: Not that I really care or anything...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_1000_friend_04
text: Anyway, our two new teammates should be\nwaiting for us inside the Zero Gate.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
